pr.title: Item categories and a category filter on the list

acceptance.evidence: test/index.test.js 'AC-1' checks seed rows, UNIQUE and CHECK rejection, nullable column, index and tagged items; migration 0003 matches.
'AC-2' test: title-only insert gets null category_id; unknown category_id raises FOREIGN KEY.

'AC-3' test checks id order, categorised markup and `
  • No category
    • `; the seeded-items test checks the First item markup.
'AC-4' test checks link order (case-insensitive), hrefs, a no-item category link and that only All is current.
'AC-5' tests check Work-only items in id order, Work current, and that extra params change nothing.
'AC-6' test checks 200, the message, no <li> and the current link.
'AC-7' test checks the escaped label, the encoded href, and that requesting that href lists the item.
it.each 'AC-8' covers all five paths: 404, message, Go back href, script, no <li>, no <nav>.
Verified by review only. I read the script in src/index.js: same-origin referrer goes back, otherwise href=/ is followed. It has an extra history.length guard (see finding). I did not run a browser.
routes.json lists the route; the traffic.test.js route and query-recording tests; tests/traffic-config.test.sh accepts a query and rejects whitespace and #; the index.test.js AC-11 test checks 2xx.
Existing tests remain (escaping, empty table, h1); the First item assertion was updated as the spec allows. healthz, 404 and 405 code paths are unchanged.
test/apply-migrations.js drops tables in one batch with defer_foreign_keys; the AC-13 test checks the reset leaves exactly 4 items. The whole suite could not be run here.

findings.what: The Go back script goes back only if `ours && history.length > 1`. The spec's decision says go back when `document.referrer` is same-origin, and rejected `history.length > 1` as a condition. This is an extra guard the decision does not state.
findings.fix: Remove `&& history.length > 1` so the condition is just the same-origin referrer.

findings.what: The state-table row '`/`, no items' is only checked for 'No items yet.' (the pre-existing test). Nothing asserts the filter links are shown with All current, the list is hidden, or Go back is hidden. No 200 state asserts that Go back is hidden.
findings.fix: Extend the empty-table test to assert the nav with All current, no <ul>/<li>, and no 'Go back' text. Also assert no 'Go back' on the 200 filter pages.

findings.what:
The 404 page adds an `

Broken link

` heading and a 'Broken link' title that the spec does not call for.
findings.fix: Drop the heading and title, or record them in the spec.

findings.what: The script assertion is a loose regex on document.referrer, location.origin and history.back(). It would still pass if the origin comparison were wrong (for example `!==`).
findings.fix: Evaluate the script in a test with a stub document and location, or tighten the regex to the exact comparison.

lenses.note: The change follows the spec's intent. Extras: the history.length guard and the Broken link heading.
The go is recorded in c72b0f1, which edits only the Go line and the open-proposal notes, not acceptance items. One decision is departed from (the history.length guard).
The test suite was not run here (npm test not attempted). Coverage is good except for the state-table gaps in the findings.
README is updated to describe the filter and the 404. Nothing stale found.
